# UsdtoWorld

> UsdtoWorld is a free, live currency converter and set of currency guides,
> centered on USD to RMB (Chinese yuan) conversion, plus USD/INR, USD/EUR,
> USD/GBP, USD/CAD, USD/AUD, USD/JPY, and USD/PKR. Rates come from a live
> market data feed; guides and FAQ answers are written and reviewed by the
> UsdtoWorld editorial team (see /about).

UsdtoWorld is not a bank, broker, or registered financial advisor, and
nothing on the site is personalized financial advice — see /disclaimer.

## Converter

- [Home / USD to RMB converter](https://usdtoworld.com/): Live USD-to-RMB
  (Chinese yuan) converter, plus quick-access shortcuts for common amounts
  and an exchange-rate table for major currencies.

## Currency pair guides

- [USD to INR](https://usdtoworld.com/usd-to-inr): Converter and guide to
  the US dollar to Indian rupee rate.
- [INR to USD](https://usdtoworld.com/inr-to-usd): Converter and guide to
  the Indian rupee to US dollar rate.
- [RUB to INR](https://usdtoworld.com/russian-currency-to-inr): Converter and guide to
  the Russian ruble to Indian rupee rate, including why retail rates in India
  differ from the mid-market rate.
- [USD to EUR](https://usdtoworld.com/usd-to-eur): Converter and guide to
  the US dollar to euro rate.
- [EUR to USD](https://usdtoworld.com/eur-to-usd): Converter and guide to
  the euro to US dollar rate.
- [USD to GBP](https://usdtoworld.com/usd-to-gbp): Converter and guide to
  the US dollar to British pound rate.
- [GBP to USD](https://usdtoworld.com/gbp-to-usd): Converter and guide to
  the British pound to US dollar rate.
- [USD to CAD](https://usdtoworld.com/usd-to-cad): Converter and guide to
  the US dollar to Canadian dollar rate.
- [USD to AUD](https://usdtoworld.com/usd-to-aud): Converter and guide to
  the US dollar to Australian dollar rate.
- [USD to JPY](https://usdtoworld.com/usd-to-jpy): Converter and guide to
  the US dollar to Japanese yen rate.
- [USD to PKR](https://usdtoworld.com/usd-to-pkr): Converter and guide to
  the US dollar to Pakistani rupee rate.
- [USD to MXN](https://usdtoworld.com/usd-to-mxn): Converter and guide to
  the US dollar to Mexican peso rate.
- [USD to HKD](https://usdtoworld.com/usd-to-hkd): Converter and guide to
  the US dollar to Hong Kong dollar rate, which is pegged within a narrow
  band rather than freely floating.
- [USD to PHP](https://usdtoworld.com/usd-to-php): Converter and guide to
  the US dollar to Philippine peso rate.
- [USD to SGD](https://usdtoworld.com/usd-to-sgd): Converter and guide to
  the US dollar to Singapore dollar rate, with a second section covering
  US dollar to Swiss franc.
